speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with weakness and fatigue; to begin our assessment, have you noticed if these symptoms have been getting worse over the last few weeks?

Also, have you experienced any changes in your appetite, weight, or sleep patterns recently?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count
REQUEST TEST: Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel

speaker: Doctor
text: The initial blood work and metabolic panel results appear to be normal. Since ruling out common causes like anemia or electrolyte imbalances, do you experience any muscle cramps, tingling sensations, or weakness specifically in your limbs? REQUEST TEST: Creatine_Kinase; REQUEST IMAGES: Muscle_MRI.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood work and metabolic panel are normal, so let's look deeper at the muscles. Do you have any history of muscle injury, recent intense exercise, or take any new medications that could affect muscle function?

REQUEST TEST: Creatine_Kinase
REQUEST IMAGES: Muscle_MRI

speaker: Doctor
text: The repeat Creatine Kinase and Muscle MRI results are also normal, which makes primary muscle disease less likely. Given your persistent weakness and fatigue with otherwise normal labs, do you notice any muscle wasting or difficulty rising from a seated position? Additionally, have you experienced any unexplained weight loss or joint pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypokalemic Periodic Paralysis or Myasthenia Gravis.

Given your normal muscle enzymes and MRI, combined with the fatigue worsening at the end of the day and recent travel/illness, do you notice specific weakness in your eyes (double vision, drooping eyelids) or difficulty swallowing? REQUEST TEST: Acetylcholine_Receptor_Antibodies; REQUEST TEST: Serum_Potassium.
